decision.message: The requested/forbidden profiles, I2C clock and pull-ups do not match a reviewed profile for esp32_sht31_v1. No alternative was substituted.

clauses.text: Can you make the SHT31 board with your low_current profile and 10k I2C pull-ups? Please declare 100 pF total capacitance.
